functions.name: data_extraction_function
functions.description: Read the IDAT files and sample sheet of a node into a long table of Beta and M values per probe and sample, with the cohort of each sample. Quality control and normalisation (pylluminator, SeSAMe-style, within each sample): pOOBAH detection p-values (probes above the threshold masked), masking of quality, control, non-CpG, SNP and X/Y-chromosome probes, optionally inference of the colour channel of type I probes, non-linear dye-bias correction and NOOB background correction. Probes missing in any sample of the hospital are left out. No between-sample (e.g. BMIQ, quantile) or batch normalisation. Each sample is marked with the share of its probes failing detection (qc_failed_fraction) and whether it is above the flag threshold (qc_flagged); flagged samples are kept. The task log has a QC summary with counts only (no sample IDs). Use 'Sample QC summary' for the counts per hospital and cohort and 'Exclude QC-flagged samples' to remove them.

arguments.name: cohort_column
arguments.description: Column in the sample sheet that holds the cohort of each sample (case-insensitive, e.g. 'Cohort').

arguments.name: sample_sheet_name
arguments.description: File name of the sample sheet in the IDAT folder. By default samplesheet.csv or sample_sheet.csv is used.

arguments.name: sample_columns
arguments.description: Other sample sheet columns to add to every row, e.g. Site. Column names become snake_case (Age at menopause -> age_at_menopause). An Age column is added automatically if the sample sheet has one (needed for the epigenetic clocks' age acceleration).

arguments.name: pvalue_threshold
arguments.description: pOOBAH detection p-value above which a probe is masked.

arguments.name: min_beads
arguments.description: Probes measured with fewer beads are masked.

arguments.name: qc_flag_fraction
arguments.display_name: QC flag: share of failed probes
arguments.description: Samples with more than this share of probes failing detection are flagged (qc_flagged column; kept). 0.1 is ChAMP's sample cut-off.

arguments.name: infer_type1_channel
arguments.display_name: Infer the colour channel of type I probes
arguments.description: SeSAMe's recommended step for EPIC: set each type I probe's channel to the one with the higher signal, before the other steps. Off by default.

functions.display_name: Extract Beta and M values from IDATs

functions.name: qc_summary
functions.description: Per hospital and cohort: samples, QC-flagged samples, samples left if the flagged ones are excluded, and whether that falls below a minimum. Counts only; sample IDs never leave the hospitals.

arguments.name: cohort_column
arguments.description: Column with the cohort of each sample

arguments.name: min_samples
arguments.display_name: Minimum samples per cohort and hospital
arguments.description: Cohorts that would fall below this many samples at a hospital after excluding the flagged samples are marked (the later analyses need 2-5)

arguments.name: organizations_to_include
arguments.description: Hospitals (organizations) to use; empty = all of the collaboration

ui_visualizations.name: Summary
ui_visualizations.description: Plain-text reading of the sample QC

ui_visualizations.name: Samples per hospital and cohort
ui_visualizations.description: Samples, QC-flagged samples and samples left after excluding the flagged ones

functions.name: partial_qc_summary
functions.description: Per cohort at this hospital: samples and QC-flagged samples (counts only)

arguments.name: cohort_column
arguments.description: Column with the cohort of each sample

functions.name: exclude_flagged_samples
functions.description: Removes the samples flagged by the extraction's QC (more failed probes than its threshold) from the session's dataframe at every hospital, in place; the extraction is not repeated. Run 'Sample QC summary' first to see how many remain.
